cards.name: hero
cards.question: Free Social Media Comment Ideas to Edit
cards.qualifier: Stuck on what to say? Describe the post, pick a tone, and get 12 comment ideas you can personalize before posting them yourself.

groups.label: Describe the post
groups.text: Paste a short excerpt or write a one-line summary.

groups.label: Edit, then post it yourself
groups.text: You get 12 comment ideas assembled from templates and the details you entered.

bad.label: Avoid
items: Never post the same comment at scale

cards.name: key-point
cards.kicker: What makes a good social media comment
cards.quote: A good comment shows you actually read or watched the post and adds something: a question, a related experience or genuine encouragement.
